40022669.author: पदार्थः
40022669.content: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, तु indeed, तत् that, वाक्यं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, शत्रुनिबर्हणः the destroyer of enemies, वृत्रघातम् the slaying of Vritra, अशेषेण completely, कथय narrate, इति thus, आह said, सुव्रत O one of good vows.

40022669.author: Translation
40022669.content: Having heard that speech of Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemies (Rama) said, "O one of good vows, narrate the slaying of Vritra completely."

40022670.author: पदार्थः
40022670.content: राघवेण by Rama, एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, तु indeed, सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः the enhancer of Sumitra's joy, भूयः again, एव indeed, कथां story, दिव्यां divine, कथयामास narrated, सुव्रतः the one of good vows.

40022670.author: Translation
40022670.content: Thus addressed by Rama, the enhancer of Sumitra's joy, who was of good vows, again narrated the divine story.

40022671.author: पदार्थः
40022671.content: सहस्राक्षवचः Indra's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सर्वेषां of all, च and, दिवौकसाम् of the gods, विष्णुः Vishnu, देवान् to the gods, उवाच said, इदं this, सर्वान् all, इन्द्रपुरोगमान् with Indra as their leader.

40022671.author: Translation
40022671.content: Having heard the words of Indra and all the gods, Vishnu spoke these words to all the gods, with Indra at their forefront.

40022672.author: पदार्थः
40022672.content: पूर्वं previously, सौहृदबद्धः bound by friendship, अस्मि I am, वृत्रस्य of Vritra, ह indeed, महात्मनः the great-souled one, तेन therefore, युष्मत्प्रियार्थं for your benefit, हि indeed, न not, अहं I, हन्मि kill, महासुरम् the great demon.

40022672.author: Translation
40022672.content: I am indeed bound by a prior friendship with the great Vritra, and therefore I cannot kill this great demon for your benefit.

40022673.author: पदार्थः
40022673.content: अवश्यं certainly, करणीयम् to be done, च and, भवतां your, सुखम् happiness, उत्तमम् supreme, तस्मात् therefore, उपायम् a means, आख्यास्ये I shall explain, येन by which, वृत्रः Vritra, निहन्यते is killed.

40022673.author: Translation
40022673.content: Your supreme happiness must certainly be achieved, therefore I shall explain a method by which Vritra can be killed.

40022674.author: पदार्थः
40022674.content: त्रिधाभूतं made into three parts, करिष्यामि I shall make, हि indeed, आत्मानं myself, सुरसत्तमाः O best of gods, तेन thereby, वृत्रं Vritra, सहस्राक्षः Indra, वधिष्यति will kill, न no, संशयः doubt.

40022674.author: Translation
40022674.content: O best of gods, I shall indeed divide myself into three parts, and thereby Indra will kill Vritra without a doubt.

40022675.author: पदार्थः
40022675.content: एकांशः one part, वासवं to Indra, यातु let it go, द्वितीयः the second, वज्रम् to the thunderbolt, एव indeed, तु and, तृतीयः the third, भूतलम् to the earth, शक्रः Indra, तदा then, वृत्रं Vritra, वधिष्यति will kill.

40022675.author: Translation
40022675.content: Let one part of me go into Indra, the second into his thunderbolt, and the third into the earth; then Indra will be able to kill Vritra.

40022676.author: पदार्थः
40022676.content: तथा thus, ब्रुवति while speaking, देवेशे to the lord of gods (Vishnu), देवाः the gods, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रुवन् spoke, एवम् thus, एतत् this, न not, सन्देहः doubt, यथा as, वदसि you speak, दैत्यहन् O slayer of demons.

40022676.author: Translation
40022676.content: When the Lord of Gods (Vishnu) spoke thus, the gods then replied, "O slayer of demons, what you say is indeed true, there is no doubt about it."

40022677.author: पदार्थः
40022677.content: भद्रम् welfare, ते to you, अस्तु let it be, गमिष्यामः we shall go, वृत्रासुरवधैषिणः desirous of killing Vritrasura, भजस्व resort to, परमोदार O most generous one, वासवम् Indra, स्वेन with your own, तेजसा might.

40022677.author: Translation
40022677.content: "May good fortune be with you; we shall now go, eager to slay Vritrasura, and O most generous one, you should empower Indra with your own might."

40022678.author: पदार्थः
40022678.content: ततः then, सर्वे all, महात्मानः the great-souled ones, सहस्राक्षपुरोगमाः with Indra at the forefront, तत् that, अरण्यम् forest, उपाक्रामन् approached, यत्र where, वृत्रः Vritra, महासुरः the great demon.

40022678.author: Translation
40022678.content: Then all the great-souled gods, led by Indra, proceeded towards that forest where the mighty demon Vritra resided.

40022679.author: पदार्थः
40022679.content: ते they, पश्यन् saw, तेजसा with splendor, भूतं endowed, तप्यन्तम् radiating heat, असुरोत्तमम् the best of demons, पिबन्तम् drinking, इव as if, लोकान् worlds, त्रीन् three, निर्दहन्तम् burning completely, इव as if, अम्बरम् the sky.

40022679.author: Translation
40022679.content: They saw the foremost of demons, Vritra, endowed with immense splendor and radiating heat, as if he were drinking up the three worlds and burning the very sky.

40022680.author: पदार्थः
40022680.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, एव indeed, च and, असुरश्रेष्ठम् the best of demons, देवाः the gods, त्रासम् fear, उपागमन् felt, कथम् how, एनम् him, वधिष्यामः shall we kill, कथम् how, न not, स्यात् may it be, पराजयः defeat.

40022680.author: Translation
40022680.content: And having seen that foremost of demons, the gods were struck with fear, wondering, "How shall we kill him? How can we avoid defeat?"

40022681.author: पदार्थः
40022681.content: तेषां of them, चिन्तयतां while thinking, तत्र there, सहस्राक्षः the thousand-eyed (Indra), पुरन्दरः the destroyer of cities (Indra), वज्रं the thunderbolt, प्रगृह्य having grasped, पाणिभ्यां with both hands, प्राहिणोत् he hurled, वृत्रमूर्धनि on Vritra's head.

40022681.author: Translation
40022681.content: While the gods were contemplating there, the thousand-eyed Indra, the destroyer of cities, grasped the thunderbolt with both hands and hurled it onto Vritra's head.

40022682.author: पदार्थः
40022682.content: कालाग्निना by the fire of time, इव as if, घोरेण terrible, तप्तेन burning, एव indeed, महार्चिषा with a great flame, पतता falling, वृत्रशिरसा by Vritra's head, जगत् the world, त्रासं terror, उपागमत् experienced.

40022682.author: Translation
40022682.content: As Vritra's head fell, burning like the terrible, great-flamed fire of universal destruction, the world experienced immense terror.

40022683.author: पदार्थः
40022683.content: असम्भाव्यं the inconceivable, वधं killing, तस्य of him, वृत्रस्य of Vritra, विबुधाधिपः the lord of gods, चिन्तयानः contemplating, जगाम he went, आशु quickly, लोकस्य of the world, अन्तं to the end, महायशाः the greatly renowned.

40022683.author: Translation
40022683.content: The greatly renowned lord of gods, contemplating the inconceivable slaying of Vritra, quickly went to a secluded corner of the world.

40022684.author: पदार्थः
40022684.content: तं that, इन्द्रं Indra, ब्रह्महत्या the sin of Brahmanicide, आशु quickly, गच्छन्तं going, अनुगच्छति followed, अपतत् it fell, च and, अस्य his, गात्रेषु on limbs, तं that, इन्द्रं Indra, दुःखं sorrow, आविशत् enveloped.

40022684.author: Translation
40022684.content: As that Indra was going, the sin of Brahmanicide quickly followed him and fell upon his limbs, enveloping him in sorrow.

40022685.author: पदार्थः
40022685.content: हतारयः whose enemies were slain, प्रनष्टेन्द्राः whose Indra was lost, देवाः the gods, साग्निपुरोगमाः with Agni as their leader, विष्णुं Vishnu, त्रिभुवनेशानं the lord of the three worlds, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, अपूजयन् they worshipped.

40022685.author: Translation
40022685.content: The gods, whose enemies were slain but whose Indra had disappeared, with Agni as their leader, repeatedly worshipped Vishnu, the lord of the three worlds.

40022686.author: पदार्थः
40022686.content: त्वं You, गतिः the refuge, परमेशान O Supreme Lord, पूर्वजः the primeval one, जगतः of the world, पिता the father, रक्षार्थं for the protection, सर्वभूतानां of all beings, विष्णुत्वम् the state of Vishnu, उपजग्मिवान् you have attained.

40022686.author: Translation
40022686.content: O Supreme Lord, you are the ultimate refuge, the primeval father of the world, who has assumed the form of Vishnu for the protection of all beings.

40022687.author: पदार्थः
40022687.content: हतः killed, च and, अयं this, त्वया by you, वृत्रः Vritra, ब्रह्महत्या the sin of Brahmanicide, च and, वासवम् Indra, बाधते afflicts, सुरशार्दूल O best among gods, मोक्षं liberation, तस्या from that, विनिर्दिश please prescribe.

40022687.author: Translation
40022687.content: O best among gods, Vritra has been killed by you, and now the sin of Brahmanicide afflicts Indra; please prescribe a means of liberation for him from this sin.

40022688.author: पदार्थः
40022688.content: तेषां their, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, देवानां of the gods, विष्णुः Vishnu, अब्रवीत् said, माम् me, एव only, यजतां let him worship, शक्रः Indra, पावयिष्यामि I shall purify, वज्रिणम् the wielder of the thunderbolt.

40022688.author: Translation
40022688.content: Having heard the words of the gods, Vishnu said, "Let Indra worship me alone, and I shall purify the wielder of the thunderbolt."

40022689.author: पदार्थः
40022689.content: पुण्येन by the sacred, हयमेधेन Ashvamedha sacrifice, माम् me, इष्ट्वा having worshipped, पाकशासनः Indra, पुनः again, एष्यति he will attain, देवानाम् of the gods, इन्द्रत्वम् the sovereignty of Indra, अकुतोभयम् fearless.

40022689.author: Translation
40022689.content: Having worshipped me with a meritorious Ashvamedha sacrifice, Indra will again attain his fearless sovereignty over the gods.

40022690.author: पदार्थः
40022690.content: एवं thus, सन्दिश्य having instructed, तां that, वाणीं speech, देवानाम् of the gods, अमृतोपमाम् nectar-like, जगाम went, विष्णुः Vishnu, देवेशः the lord of gods, स्तूयमानः being praised, त्रिविष्टपम् to heaven.

40022690.author: Translation
40022690.content: Having thus delivered that nectar-like message to the gods, Vishnu, the lord of gods, returned to heaven, being praised by them. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चाशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 85 ।। Thus ends the eighty-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
